conflict_state_machine.SELECTED_SAME_TIER_NEWEST: same trust_tier + different observed_at → newest selected; ConflictRecord keeps ALL sides with full evidence; conflict.status=RECORDED (never erased)
conflict_state_machine.SELECTED_HIGHER_TIER: different trust_tier → higher tier selected (official_verified > secondary_verified > reference > inferred); lower-tier observation retained verbatim in ConflictRecord
conflict_state_machine.QUARANTINED: same tier + same/unparseable date + different values, or contamination-guard failure, or provenance gap → NO selected value emitted; conflict.status=QUARANTINED; assembled field absent from accepted output
conflict_state_machine.REJECTED_JOIN: display-string-only key not resolvable through packets + alias catalog → join_errors.jsonl entry, no assembled row
conflict_state_machine.PROPOSED: AI proposal (separate file) referencing packet_ids — NEVER auto-applied; human/acceptance path only
conflict_state_machine.RESOLVED_CANONICAL: reconcile() assigns deterministic canonical_id to a group of candidate_ids; candidate_id ALWAYS retained

trust_and_role_rules.provenance_state: ACQUISITION_VERIFIED vs LEGACY_UNVERIFIED preserved per observation; legacy/unverified never presented as verified (flag `verified: false` carried into output)
trust_and_role_rules.value_universe: assembled values must be ⊆ union of packet observation values (no enrichment from canonical DB — J)
